g.text: Lead time starts when the brief lands, not at the first spec commit.
Phase 1 is the owner's time: the brief, the spec, gate H1.
Phase 2 runs without the owner: plan, tasks, reviews, fixes.
Phase 3 is the machine check and the merge.
The page shows the total and each phase. Spec 029's page said 1.7 h.
